spans.s:
आढ्य a. [आ-ध्यै-क-पृषो˚ Tv.]
1 Rich, wealthy; आढ्योऽ
भिजनवानस्मि कोन्योस्ति सदृशो मया

.
--2 (a) Rich
in, abounding in, possessing
abundantly, with instr. or as the
last member of comp.; सत्य˚

; एवमादिगुणैराढ्यः Vet.;
समुद्रमिव रत्नाढ्यं Rām. (b) Mixed with,
watered with; गंधाढ्य; स्रज
उत्तमगंधाढ्याः Mb.; मूत्राढ्यैः करंजफलसर्षपैः
Suśr.
--3 Abundant, copious.
--Comp.
--आडु a. striving to get wealth.
--कुलीन a. [आढ्यकुले भवः ख]
Descended from a rich family.
--चर
a. (री f.) [भूतपूर्व आढ्यः चरट्] once
opulent.
--वातः [आढ्यो वातो यत्र] a
convulsive or rheumatic palsy of
the loins.

] Enriching.
--णं The means
of enriching, wealth, prosperity.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.
